preserved_v1.classification: Healthy selected API holds its existing GPU lease. The read-only lock probe deferred before prepare namespace, build claim or tools. Not a compiler/native fault.

recommended_scope: New build-v2 four-source package, same recipes/artifacts/resource classes and separate prepare/compile phases; only lease/claim observation plus proof namespaces change. Preserve build-v1 entirely. No native rebuild until separate compile admission; no numerical/native execution.

lease.purpose: Exclusive nonblocking flock serializes every new CPU build controller sharing this path. It does not acquire, replace, unlink or unlock experiment.lock.
lease.open: Canonical owned directory; O_CREAT|O_RDWR|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC, mode0600; fstat regular, one hardlink, expected user, and named-path inode/device equality. Keep inode on disk after release; never delete/recreate an existing lock.
lease.lifetime: Acquire before any canonical claim or prepare/build namespace; hold through all children, cleanup, own claim release and final selected-owner verification. Descriptor not inherited by exec children.
lease.record: Controller PID, Linux start ticks, unique nonce, mode, q pin, exact selected binding and CPU-lock device/inode. Fresh per-attempt receipts; no stale-claim auto-clear or retry.

GPU_lease_observation.input: Exact existing experiment.lock canonical regular path, stable fstat device/inode; /proc/locks observed read-only.
GPU_lease_observation.require: Exactly one matching FLOCK ADVISORY WRITE row, PID equals selected API MainPID, range0 EOF; reject missing/malformed/ambiguous/foreign holder or blocked waiter for this inode. Check device major/minor and inode, not inode alone. Pin selected systemd invocation/MainPID/native-startticks via unchanged host.guard_binding before and after observation.
GPU_lease_observation.repeated: Before claim, before/after each child, during <=1s child guard loop and after cleanup; preserve raw matching row plus path identity in receipts. Never substitute nativePID for API lease holder.
GPU_lease_observation.limit: Read-only observation, not acquisition of the production lock or proof of exclusivity against noncooperating processes.

canonical_claim.method: Within held CPU flock, reuse pinned optimistic compare/readback state helper to set active_cpu_build to unique owned record after fresh phase-free genuine-idle/current-binding/root136 guards. Verify own record each guard.
canonical_claim.release: Only after owned children/groups gone; reread current state, require exact owned record, preserve every other current field, CAS only active_cpu_build=False. Never clear another owner or restore a stale whole-state snapshot. Preserve primary and cleanup/release/owner faults.
canonical_claim.critical_limit: This is atomic CPU-controller serialization only. Existing legacy phase writers do not acquire cpu-build.lock, and existing cas_state is not a global atomic compare-and-swap. Root must freeze all other maintenance/controller launches while this CPU lease is held. Guards detect conflicting state/owner changes and stop owned compilation, but do not eliminate a simultaneous uncooperative writer race.
canonical_claim.admission_required: Explicit single-coordinator/no-other-controller-launch condition in qualification and action-time admission; if this operational condition cannot be ensured, this design is insufficient and requires separately reviewed common writer coordination rather than pretending the lock fixes global CAS.
canonical_claim.crash: OS releases flock but canonical claim remains. Subsequent invocation refuses stale/nonempty claim; no automatic cleanup/retry. Root must separately verify any orphan child group before recovery.

documentation.scope: FLOCK type, owner PID, device/inode and range fields; OFD PID -1 is not acceptable here.
Nonblocking exclusive advisory lock; lock follows open file description and is released when all descriptors close. It cannot force uncooperative writers to participate.
